lines.vo: Why does saying I can't have that make you want it even more?
That's not just your sweet tooth. The words you pick might matter.
Kev keeps a no candy streak in his Break the Habit tracker.
In one study, about 120 students practiced saying either I can't, or I don't, when tempted.
On the way out, they were offered a chocolate bar or a granola bar.
Nearly two thirds of the I don't group took the granola bar, versus under 40 percent of the I can't group.
I can't sounds like a rule. I don't sounds like who you are.
I don't break my streak. That's how you stay on track.

hook: Saying *I can't* makes you want it more
